plain: A Michigan urgent care clinic says patient data was exposed in a September hack that a ransomware gang has claimed.
summary: The Michigan clinic disclosed an incident first identified on September 11 in which data was accessed and exposed by an unauthorized party. The INC Ransom group listed the clinic on its leak site; the clinic has not named an attacker. The number affected is not yet public. Data likely includes names, birth dates, diagnoses, prescriptions and insurance information.
title: Lansing Urgent Care discloses data exposure; INC Ransom claims the attack
